senses.gloss:
ITA-9.2.65 niragni-upanāhasvedaḥ निरग्नि-उपनाहस्वेदः
Sweating induced by applying a medicated herbal poultice
A type of sudation therapy in which diaphoresis is achieved by application of a paste which prevents body heat from escaping.

ITA-9.2.57 niragnisvedaḥ निरग्निस्वेदः
Sweating induced without application of fire
Sudation procedures which do not rely on the direct or indirect application of fire.

ITA-5.6.39 nirāmaḥ निरामज्वरः
Fever devoid- of ama, post-ama stage of fever
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: return of appetite; wasted/dried up/emaciated; feeling of lightness in body parts; lessening of fever/mild fever; passage of excreta; absence of clinical features of āmajvara.

ITA-4.8.24 nirāmadoṣaḥ निरामदोषः
Dosha not associated with ama
When ama associated with dosha undergoes depletion, the resultant dosha is termed devoid of ama state; it is still in a vitiated state and has not returned to normal state.

ITA-4.6.5 nirāmāvasthā निरामावस्था
Transformative stage devoid of ama pathology
The state when ama is converted either under the effect of time or by therapeutic measures.

ITA-5.76.98 āsthāpanāpacāraḥ/ nirūhabastyapacāraḥ आस्थापनापचारः/ निरूहबस्त्यपचारः
Condition due to improper administration of decoction enema

ITA-5.76.100 nirūhabastyayogaḥ निरूहबस्त्ययोगः
Condition due to inadequate or subnormal administration of evacuative; non-oily decoction enema
A condition characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: headache; pain in precordial region/angina pectoris; pain in anal region; pain in urinary bladder or basti; pain in genital region; oedema; cold catarrh; gripping pain; nausea; retention of flatus; obstruction to passage of urine/ retention; breathlessness/difficulty in breathing; excessive salivation; precordial discomfort with nausea; feeling of abdominal fullness; aggravation of kapha and pitta; abdominal distension; loss of taste; vomiting; drowsiness/lassitude; sensation of being covered with a wet cloth; diminution of agni; heaviness of body; severe burning sensation; itching; retention of faeces; giddiness or dizziness; papules.

ITA-5.76.101 nirūhamithyāyogaḥ निरूहमिथ्यायोगः
Condition of improper administration of medicated non-oily enema

ITA-5.76.99 nirūhātiyogaḥ निरूहातियोगः
Condition due to excessively administered evacuative; non-oily enema
A condition characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: numbness; generalized body aches; exhaustion without exertion; shivering/tremors; insomnia; debility; feeling of entering into darkness; insanity; hiccups; syncope or swooning; rectal prolapse; excessive elimination of kapha; onset of colicky pain; watery discharge without dosha; blood tinged watery discharge; watery discharge resembling fatty meat washings; watery discharge resembling raw meat washings; shiny watery discharge resembling fat; oil or water mixed with fatty substances; blackish watery discharge; whitish watery discharge; thirst; agravates vata; giddiness or dizziness; protruding eyes.

ITA-9.6.15 nirghātanakarma निर्घातनकर्म
Manual loosening of impacted foreign body
The manual processes for loosening and/or removing an impacted foreign body.

ITA-1.6.18 nirṇayaḥ निर्णयः
Decision based on critical analysis
A decisive statement which reaches a conclusion or settles a topic after detailed consideration of all relevant and related facts.

ITA-1.6.19 nirdeśaḥ निर्देशः
Detailed description, elaboration of statement
A detailed description of previously listed topics.

ITA-9.6.210 nirdhmāpanakarma निर्ध्मापनकर्म
Removal of foreign body by insufflation
The removal of a loosely impacted foreign body by insufflation or blowing of air.

ITA-9.9.29 nirbījaśukram निर्बीजशुक्रम्
Azoospermia
The absence of sperm in the semen.

ITA-7.2.1.5 nirmalīkaraṇam निर्मलीकरणम्
Removal of physical impurities

ITA-5.72.10 niryāsa-viṣaḥ निर्यास-विषः
Poisonous gums; resins
Poisoning characterized by halitosis; roughness/dryness; headache; secretion of mucus.

ITA-7.1.4 kvāthaḥ, śṛtaḥ, niryūhaḥ क्वाथः, शृतः, निर्यूहः
Decoction

ITA-1.6.20 nirvacanam निर्वचनम्
Technical definition
An illustrative statement understood only by experts with the specific domain knowledge.

ITA-7.2.1.9 nirvāpaṇam/nimajjanam निर्वापणम्/निमज्जनम्
Immersion of heated solid in liquid

ITA-9.6.143 nirvāpaṇakarma (vraṇacikitsā) निर्वापणकर्म (व्रणचिकित्सा)
Application of demulcent for wound management
Application of cooling substances to a wound with a burning sensation.

ITA-1.8.1.3 nirvikalpakam निर्विकल्पकम्
Indeterminate perception
Direct perception, observation without specific details of the cognitive process.

ITA-1.9.3.2.19 nirvikāram निर्विकारम्
Formless
A quality of soul which is devoid of all bodily and psychological ailments.

ITA-9.5.49 nirvedhima निर्वेधिः
Lobuloplasty type 7
A type of lobuloplasty indicated when both flaps of the divided earlobe are absent upto the root and it is repaired with the tragus as the base.
